0022600177.text: The Knicks (2-4, 11th in the East) host the Bulls (1-5, 13th in the East), with New York coming off a loss in its most recent game and Chicago on a four-game losing streak. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton, who is out with a hamstring injury. The teams have met once this season, with the Knicks winning 133-127 in Chicago on October 28, and New York won the 2025-26 season series 3-1.
